# Cryptography (Web Crypto API)

> Part of the [Implementation Status](README.md) index. `crypto.subtle` is Node's own `lib/internal/crypto/webcrypto.js` in TypeScript (`lib/node/internal_crypto_webcrypto*.ts`), written over the `node:crypto` module, whose natives come from the crypto library selected with `-crypto`: OpenSSL 3 libcrypto (default, all platforms) or Apple CommonCrypto + Security.framework (`-crypto=commoncrypto`, macOS only, out of scope) ([TDD-00104](../tdd/TDD-00104.md)). `crypto.getRandomValues`/`randomUUID` need only a real CSPRNG (`arc4random_buf`/`getrandom()`), no external library.

**Coverage**: 16/18 (~89%) · **Strict Coverage**: 3/18 (~17%).

Format: [Status page format](README.md#status-page-format).

| Feature | Status | Caveats | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `crypto.getRandomValues(view)` | ✅ | • A whole `ArrayBuffer` is accepted as a deliberate extension (real JS throws `TypeMismatchError` — only integer TypedArrays are spec-legal) ([ADR-00554](../adr/ADR-00554.md)) | • The spec's 65,536-byte quota is enforced — an oversize view throws `QuotaExceededError`; a float TypedArray (`Float32Array`/`Float64Array`) is a compile-time rejection, matching the spec's `TypeMismatchError` ([ADR-00554](../adr/ADR-00554.md))<br>• Fills any integer TypedArray/`ArrayBuffer` in place and returns it ([ADR-00317](../adr/ADR-00317.md)); the legacy plain-`number[]` form (one random byte value per element) still works<br>• See [ADR-00024](../adr/ADR-00024.md) |
| `crypto.randomUUID()` | ✅ | | • RFC 4122 version-4 UUID string<br>• See [ADR-00024](../adr/ADR-00024.md) |
| `crypto.subtle.digest(algo, data)` | ✅ | | • SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384, SHA-512 over any BufferSource → `Promise<ArrayBuffer>`; an unknown name rejects with `NotSupportedError`<br>• See [ADR-00316](../adr/ADR-00316.md), [ADR-01347](../adr/ADR-01347.md) |
| `crypto.subtle.encrypt` / `.decrypt` | ✅ | • On `-crypto=commoncrypto` the asymmetric algorithms (RSA, EC, Ed25519, X25519) fail: they run over `node:crypto`'s KeyObject, which that backend does not provide | • AES-CTR (`counter`, `length`), AES-CBC, AES-GCM (`iv`, `additionalData`, `tagLength`) and RSA-OAEP (`label`), with Node's errors; a failure rejects with `OperationError`<br>• See [ADR-01347](../adr/ADR-01347.md) |
| `crypto.subtle.sign` / `.verify` | ✅ | • On `-crypto=commoncrypto` the asymmetric algorithms (RSA, EC, Ed25519, X25519) fail: they run over `node:crypto`'s KeyObject, which that backend does not provide | • HMAC, RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5, RSA-PSS (`saltLength`), ECDSA (P-256/P-384/P-521, IEEE P1363 signatures) and Ed25519<br>• See [ADR-01347](../adr/ADR-01347.md) |

| Node `crypto` module: `createHash`/`createHmac` (`Hash`/`Hmac`: `update`/`digest`/`copy`), `hash`, `getHashes` | ✅ | • On `-crypto=commoncrypto`: `md5`/`sha1`/`sha224`/`sha256`/`sha384`/`sha512` only — SHAKE, SHA-3, SHA-512/t, RIPEMD-160 and BLAKE2 throw `Digest method not supported` | • Node's lib/internal/crypto/hash.js in TypeScript over the backend's incremental digest contexts: every digest the backend has (`shake128`/`shake256` with `outputLength`), Node's argument validation and error codes (`ERR_CRYPTO_HASH_FINALIZED`, `ERR_INVALID_ARG_TYPE`, `Digest method not supported`)<br>• See [ADR-01300](../adr/ADR-01300.md) |
